snippet.title: Back in the Swamp - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Back in the Swamp on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301420/Back_in_the_Swamp/

A post-apocalyptic and atmospheric First-Person Point & Click adventure set in a swampy wasteland. Explore and find the right combination of objects to trigger animated scenes and continue investigating to unravel the mystery of the mutant plague.

Merci à Alexia Gs pour le son !

#PointAndClick #PostApocalyptic #Wasteland #IndieGame #hiddenobjectgame
